scope: Generated accepted R2 arithmetic only; no original-game payload or capture. Reverse order values are comparison evidence, never production resources.
selection_basis: Explicit HD assembly convention, independently reviewed offline. Original normal-bank lobes are disjoint; Christmas originals differ and are excluded.
operation: Exact Porter-Duff source-over on existing 8-bit straight RGBA; independent half-up quantization of exact alpha and straight RGB once. Existing encoded RGB space; no linear-light conversion.
energy_units: Alpha sum is sum of 8-bit codes; RGB numerators are sum(C*A) in existing encoded RGB. Weighted luma uses2126R+7152G+722B; not physical radiometric energy.
limits: Offline arithmetic and reviewed art only. Diagnostic runtime qualification is recorded separately; no ordinary P5 purchase or actual-game PASS.
